snippet.title: EVO RNG — Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
EVO RNG is slot-machine god-game - draft creatures, press spin and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge and evolve on its own. Collect, chase paylines, food chains and mythic creatures. Game does not contain any real money gambling elements.

Developed by PalaGames.

Game/Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5389650/EVO_RNG/?beta=0

Discover indie games at https://www.checkpointzero.net/
Submit your trailer: https://www.checkpointzero.net/submit-trailer
